environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in a public subnet with an Application Load Balancer. The SQS queue (report-generation-queue) has a resource policy allowing sqs:SendMessage from any AWS principal (Principal: '*'). The ALB forwards health check traffic on port 8080 and the service exposes an admin endpoint at /api/admin/enqueue that allows direct message submission to the queue for debugging. No network restrictions on who can send messages to the SQS queue.

config.admin_endpoint: /api/admin/enqueue accepts POST with arbitrary message body
